objective: Implement a deterministic Digital Twin Fill / Slippage layer that reuses canonical P17-B HistoricalExecutionSimulator, binds every simulation to P19-D incident lineage, and measures modeled fill, slippage, fees, latency and partial-fill behavior without creating any execution authority or production-accuracy claim.
scope: Keep P17-B as the sole execution-realism owner
Bind each Digital Twin request to canonical P19-D incident replay root and P19-C/P19-A shadow lineage
Drive P17-B HistoricalExecutionSimulator from an exact ordered market/context timeline
Aggregate deterministic full/partial/no-fill status, fill IDs, VWAP, adverse slippage bps, fees and consumed depth diagnostics
Preserve P17-B latency, participation and point-in-time context semantics
Classify context quality as EXPLICIT_HISTORICAL_DEPTH or DERIVED_REFERENCE_DEPTH
Forbid production fill-accuracy claims from reference/derived depth
Fail closed on asset/scale/timeline/context mismatch or non-monotonic replay order
Generate deterministic same-run P19-E reference evidence linked to P19-D
out_of_scope: Real order submission or broker truth
tests: Same request/timeline produces identical Digital Twin result identity
P17-B remains the reported execution-realism owner
Full fill aggregates deterministic VWAP/slippage/fee diagnostics
Latency can defer fill to a later market slice
Latency beyond all slices produces NO_FILL
DERIVED_REFERENCE_DEPTH can never claim production fill accuracy
Incident replay root and shadow lineage are content-addressed into request/result identity
P19-E evidence is byte-identical across two runs
evidence: P17-B execution realism identity and diagnostics
rollback: Revert P19-E package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P19-A..P19-D remain canonical complete and P19-F remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
